environment.description: Same application deployed on EKS 1.27 in namespace 'processing-prod'. Calico CNI with a GlobalNetworkPolicy (order: 100) applying to pods matching label app=file-processor. The policy spec includes an egress rule with a 'Deny' action for destination nets 169.254.169.254/32 on all ports, combined with a namespace-scoped NetworkPolicy that allows egress only to the cluster DNS (kube-dns on UDP/53) and the internal service mesh sidecar (127.0.0.1/32). The GlobalNetworkPolicy uses applyOnForward: true and preDNAT: false selectors. Note: standard Kubernetes NetworkPolicy alone cannot block link-local addresses in all CNI implementations, but Calico's GlobalNetworkPolicy with iptables-based enforcement at the pod veth interface handles link-local/metadata blocking before NAT.
